name: Żary County (Poland)
description: Yellow field crossed by a diagonal band of white and red from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the county arms of Żary: a red shield with a yellow stag's antler, an arrow and a star.
history: Polish county (powiat) and city flags are established by resolution of the council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
